program: AI Solution Architect — Agentic AI & Real-Time Trading Systems

criteria.notes: Canonical replay and IG adapters are tested offline. A second independent live source plus captured live replay evidence are still required.
Stale, duplicate, out-of-order, future timestamp, missing price and spread-quality controls are tested.
Deterministic indicators, patterns, structure and market-regime classification are covered by CI.
Reproducible event-driven mechanics, explicit costs, chronological OOS and walk-forward contracts are tested. This does not assert real-market alpha.
No production probabilistic claim is made. Existing calibration evidence is synthetic and remains lab-only.
Specialized agents preserve UNKNOWN, DATA_STALE, CONFLICT and terminal deterministic VETO states.
Authentication, scopes, allowlist, validation, rate limits, timeouts and audit redaction fail closed in tests.
Deterministic risk remains authoritative and review approval is separated from agent identity.
No synthetic fixture is accepted. One hundred unique PAPER/SHADOW signals on live or recorded real-market input must be closed with realized-R outcome evidence.
OpenTelemetry, metrics, alerts, identity and security controls are tested in CI, but retained live end-to-end telemetry evidence is pending.
CRC/RHOAI/ARO deployment contracts are tested, but live cluster deployment and verification evidence remain pending.
Policies and targets are documented. Measured resilience drills, RTO/RPO, Azure cost and carbon evidence remain pending.
A 30-minute architecture/interview demonstration sequence is versioned with explicit non-claims.
Trading capabilities are mapped to banking, payments, fraud, insurance, cybersecurity and real-time decisioning patterns.
